title: Observability weekly - 2026-04-06
body:
SUMMARY:
- This week focused on stabilizing the new tracing sampling rollout, finishing the initial cost-telemetry dashboards, and iterating on alert noise reduction for SLOs.
- Rolled sampling changes to 50% of production traffic for endpoints behind the API gateway. Initial ingestion cost for traces down ~22% in the sampled cohort.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Tracing sampling config (INF-4312) deployed to Canary -> 50%: preliminary telemetry shows 22% drop in trace ingestion cost and no observable regression in error-rate detection for top-level SLOs.
- New cost telemetry Grafana dashboard published: "Cost per model / region" and "Cost per 1M tokens" panels (see linked Grafana). Product & Finance requested a view filtered by dedicated vs hosted.
- Dashboard refresh: replaced legacy RPC heatmap with new per-route p95 timeline; dashboard load times improved by ~30% after query optimization.

KEY METRICS (week over week):
- Trace ingestion cost (sampled cohort): -22%
- Span volume (traced requests): -48% (expected due to sampling)
- Alert noise (pager incidents from SLO alerts): -18% after rule tuning
- Dashboard query latency (median): -30%
- p95 end-to-end request latency (observability job): 210ms (was 320ms pre-kernel-change)

STANDUP / DAILY LOGS:
Mon 2026-04-06
- Ava: Finalized roll forwarding for sampling config. Filed follow-up (JIRA-INF-4389) for per-route overrides.
- Liam: Dashboard query refactor merged (PR #218). Observed faster load times in staging.
- Priya: Cost pipeline ETL validation; found duplications in region tag for some events; fixing mapper.
- Ethan: Worked on trace ingestion backpressure - tuned consumer group parallelism.
- Sofia: Prepared runbook snippets for oncall related to newly sampled traces.

Tue 2026-04-07
- Ava: Monitoring the 50% rollout; no increase in missed SLO detections after 24h.
- Liam: Added "cost-per-1M-tokens" panel and a breakdown by dedicated/hosted. Seeking finance feedback.
- Priya: Deployed mapper fix to staging; running backfill reconciliation job.
- Ethan: Confirmed Kafka consumer rebalance stability after parallelism changes.
- Sofia: Drafted short external note for dedicated customers about sampling behavior and visibility.

Wed 2026-04-08
- Ava: Spike on per-route sampling overrides (blocked on decision about default sampling floor).
- Liam: Investigated a few slow queries on the traces-overview dashboard; added caching for heavy aggregation.
- Priya: Backfill job 40% complete; found 2% of events missing model tag — tracking in INF-4325.
- Ethan: End-to-end test for trace export to long-term storage passed.
- Sofia: Updated oncall playbook with steps to escalate trace ingestion issues.

Thu 2026-04-09
- Ava: Meeting with Product to discuss sampling visibility for key customers. Action: add flag to surface sampled rate on per-endpoint metrics.
- Liam: Polished dashboard filters and added quick links to corresponding traces in Honeycomb.
- Priya: Cleaned up ETL schema; reduced mapper failures by ~90% in staging.
- Ethan: Deployed retention policy tweak to reduce storage costs for debug spans.
- Sofia: Runbook review with SRE; added throttling thresholds.

Fri 2026-04-10
- Team sync: Reviewed week metrics and aligned on next steps.
- Decided to keep sampling at 50% for an additional week, pending Finance signoff.
- Small postmortem on last Friday's dashboard incident: root cause was an unbounded query in cached panel.

MEETING NOTES (Observability weekly sync 2026-04-10):
- Agenda: rollout status, cost dashboards, SLO alert tuning, runbook updates.
- Rollout: still stable at 50%. Product requested a grace period for dedicated customers. Action: create per-customer sampling exemptions (Ava).
- Cost dashboards: Finance requested "month-to-date estimated cost" panel and ability to split by cloud region; Liam to add.
- SLO tuning: agreed to move guardrails from a static threshold to a dynamic baseline for noisy routes (Ethan to prototype).
- Runbook: validated steps for trace-backfill and storage tiering. Sofia to finalize document and link in Confluence.

ACTION ITEMS (owners):
- Ava: Create design doc for per-route and per-customer sampling overrides (JIRA-INF-4389) — due 2026-04-14.
- Liam: Add MTD estimated cost and dedicated/hosted split to cost dashboard — PR by 2026-04-13.
- Priya: Finish backfill reconciliation job and close INF-4325 — target 2026-04-12.
- Ethan: Prototype dynamic baseline alerting for noisy routes and run test on staging — demo 2026-04-15.
- Sofia: Publish updated runbook and link in Confluence runbook page — done by 2026-04-11.

BLOCKERS / RISKS:
- Per-route sampling floor: need Product decision on minimum sampling to preserve end-to-end observability for critical customers. This blocks INF-4389.
- Finance signoff required to keep sampling at 50% for hosted customers beyond the trial week — otherwise we'll need to rollback to 30%.
- Missing model tags in ~2% of historical events (INF-4325) — impacts cost attribution to models until backfill completes.

NOTES / TODOs (notes-to-self style):
- Need a quick metric on "fraction of requests with sampled trace" per endpoint (dashboard tile).
- Consider a lightweight sampled-trace exporter that includes only high-level spans to reduce storage while preserving debug value.
- Follow up with Product on customer-facing wording re: sampling and visibility.

REFERENCES / LINKS:
- Cost telemetry dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/observability/cost-telemetry
- Traces overview: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/observability/traces-overview
- Jira: INF-4312 (sampling rollout), INF-4389 (per-route overrides), INF-4325 (missing tags)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/218

NEXT WEEK (2026-04-13 to 2026-04-17):
- Finalize sampling overrides design and start implementing per-route flags.
- Complete backfill and reconcile cost attribution gaps.
- Add Finance requested panels to cost dashboard and solicit feedback.
- Prototype dynamic baseline alerting for noisy routes.

QUICK WIN IDEAS:
- Add sampled-rate header to request logs so customers can easily tell when a request was sampled.
- Small FAQ for customer portal explaining sampling tradeoffs and expected visibility.

END
